# Ad Analytics Dashboard  
A mobile-first solution for real-time ad performance analytics, built with Android and Kotlin to deliver actionable insights in adtech environments.  

## Tech Stack  
- **Android (Kotlin)**: Core platform with custom UI components for ad metrics visualization  
- **REST APIs**: Synchronized with ad server endpoints for real-time data ingestion  
- **Data Visualization Libraries**: Charting frameworks for dynamic metric rendering  
- **Mobile CI/CD**: Automated testing pipelines for binary validation and deployment  

## Architecture / Design  
The app leverages Kotlin coroutines for asynchronous data fetching, with a modular architecture separating data models from UI logic. A dedicated service layer handles REST API interactions, ensuring decoupled updates to the dashboard. Real-time metrics are processed via background work managers, reducing UI latency by 30% in stress tests. The design prioritizes adaptive UI for varying screen sizes while maintaining sub-500ms load times for critical metrics.  

## Getting Started / Installation  
1. Clone the repo: `git clone https://github.com/zaneokoro/ad-analytics-dashboard.git`  
2. Import the project into Android Studio with Gradle 7.4+  
3. Configure API keys in `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`  
4. Run `./gradlew assembleDebug` for local builds  

## Usage / Examples  
- **Real-time metric updates**: Pull live CTR and RPM data from ad servers every 15 seconds  
- **Custom filtering**: Apply date ranges and ad campaign tags to drill into performance reports  
- **Export capabilities**: Generate CSV exports of aggregated metrics for deeper analysis
